requirements.sourceBehavior: On HTTP 401, Grok refreshes credentials and retries the request once
requirements.evidence: Grok user-guide 02-authentication.md Automatic Credential Refresh. Not re-observed with a revoked token
requirements.piMapping: Omitted. Pi owns request recovery. isRetryableAssistantError rejects this 401. See decisions.md D5.
requirements.reason: A package-level retry would be a second recovery path around the credential lock. Pi does not treat this 401 as retryable.

requirements.sourceBehavior: Grok reloads ~/.grok/auth.json before the next request without a restart
requirements.evidence: Grok user-guide 02-authentication.md Hot Reload. Pi AuthStorage reloads on file revision
requirements.piMapping: AuthStorage reload on the next ModelRuntime.getAuth
requirements.acceptanceTest: extensions/pi-xai-oauth/test/pi-owned-auth.test.ts::Pi creates auth.json owner-only, reloads an external rewrite, and logout clears it

requirements.sourceBehavior: XAI_API_KEY is a non-OAuth fallback, with conflicting precedence in Grok's README and user guide
requirements.evidence: Grok README says the API key wins. User guide says the session token wins
requirements.piMapping: Excluded. Built-in xai provider owns API keys at api.x.ai
requirements.reason: API-key auth is not the subscription OAuth flow, and the package must not send an API key to the proxy under OAuth semantics.
